name: @midi-to-xml/audiotool-to-midi
description: Extract Audiotool project note data and turn it into standard MIDI.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && find dist test -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @midi-to-xml/midi-to-musicxml && npm run build && node --test "test/**/*.test.js"
